searchText: seems like etherscan shows gas price 0 and max fee 0 for pending 1559 txs was just noticing that - wasn't sure if i screwed something up 17301 no priority fee txs so far I looked at testing the `0x48 BASEFEE` opcode. Solidity PR was waiting to make sure the fork went okay. The other method was to use `verbatim` in Yul, but that is not available as an inline yet. So I think you can do it, by deploying a `.yul` contract with the function: ``` { function basefee() -> out { out := verbatim_0i_1o(hex"48") } sstore(0, basefee()) } ``` https://github.com/ethereum/solidity/pull/11647#issuecomment-891805433 Which I tried to do in Hardhat, but didn't manage to get `.yul` contracts to compile there. You could just write that as byetcode directly: `48600055` Oh, I see. Then it can be as an inline. So you could save the basefee to memory like so? ``` assembly {48600052} ``` No I mean instead of using Solidity just write the byte code 🙂 I thought you just want a simple test case like above. If you need something more complex, then at least in Solidity you'll need to wait for the next release. Okay, great thanks 🙂 <@&652918665943056397> <@&836981603216654336> sorry for the tag, trying to finalize this rpc spec amendment: https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-specs/pull/251#pullrequestreview-716283338 What do you return for `gasPrice` on pending EIP-1559 transaction? It seems like the options are 1) `maxFeePerGas` or 2) the `effectiveGasPrice` based on the latest block. It appears that geth does 2). I can make a PR to change it to do 1), but not sure if others are already doing 2)? If so, could modify the RPC spec. I thought geth returned `maxFeePerGas` on pending txns? I also thought this, but it doesn't look to be the case: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/d3e3a460ec947c9e1e963d1a35f887d95f23f99d/internal/ethapi/api.go#L1333-L1339 Ah, actually i'm still misinterpreting it - it passes an empty hash. Let me just make a couple test transaction to see. <@!543900561460822016>, <@!680337202521440470> has an open pr that has been waiting, pending clarity https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/pull/2535 it returns effectivePriorityFeePerGas, I believe it is in-line with your proposal. I am double checking to be sure since Karim is on PTO ``` > params = { from: me, to: me, maxFeePerGas: "0x1000000000", maxTipPerGas: "0x0", gas: "0x5208" } { from: "0xc0ffee61108b46c8b84c63df14e3a607ac981e93", gas: "0x5208", maxFeePerGas: "0x1000000000", maxTipPerGas: "0x0", to: "0xc0ffee61108b46c8b84c63df14e3a607ac981e93" } > personal.sendTransaction(params) "0xd7291f16ce57eb4e6aaae4b3d81f3f16ed947763cbed230eef3d9d1cb395fa5d" > eth.getTransaction("0xd7291f16ce57eb4e6aaae4b3d81f3f16ed947763cbed230eef3d9d1cb395fa5d") { accessList: [], blockHash: null, blockNumber: null, chainId: "0x5", from: "0xc0ffee61108b46c8b84c63df14e3a607ac981e93", gas: 21000, gasPrice: 0, hash: "0xd7291f16ce57eb4e6aaae4b3d81f3f16ed947763cbed230eef3d9d1cb395fa5d", input: "0x", maxFeePerGas: "0x1000000000", maxPriorityFeePerGas: "0x12a05f1f9", nonce: 0, r: "0x10f320d15d1d8c84ae687c9f446379d5c4c76e16146361349002e0af77996fc0", s: "0x23c3e3bf21d272a1978f8923603171e462740764f5e03c1ef859f318fc72b34d", to: "0xc0ffee61108b46c8b84c63df14e3a607ac981e93", transactionIndex: null, type: "0x2", v: "0x1", value: 0 } ``` it looks like the RPC is actually returning `0` for pending txs gas price it seems like for pending txs it returns `maxFeePerGas` like 1) above? https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/blob/71ddec15e313709ef27c4cc2028ecb4d00c34360/ethereum/api/src/main/java/org/hyperledger/besu/ethereum/api/jsonrpc/internal/results/TransactionPendingResult.java#L89 Ok, we can update the PR to reflect the final. I think Karim was waiting on consensus about RPC I don't think we have a strong preference in either direction unless anyone objects, i think we can go with returning `maxFeePerGas` as `gasPrice` for pending txs since that is what the original spec change requested and geth is doing neither 1) or 2) geth PR to do 1): https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/23345 Should we move this to <#745077610685661265> for more visibility? sure does etherscan run geth? i wonder if that's why they were seeing this issue I think they run OpenEthereum, but not sure that's what i thought too they run both, OE as primary and Geth as backup We're returning maxFeePerGas as GasPrice for pending transactions, so option number 1 🙂 thank you for letting me know 🙏 If you hit getTransactionByHash, currently geth returns: For mined TX * The effective gas price For pending TX: * The GasPrice for legacy type0 and type1 Txs, (Legacy) * Null for Type2 Txs -- The type field is always there so its an easy fix in the geth consumer side.. if Tx is type 2, then `gasPrice = maxFeePerGas` <@!765999676704555080> you mean 0 not null, right? actually, now i wonder if it actually is null and the geth console coerced it to 0 i opened a PR to fix this earlier: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/23345 at the time i tried... was null, perhaps they changed that... let me check okay yes, it appears `gasPrice` is actually null - thank you for noting this

excerpts.author: .ethere
excerpts.content:
If you hit getTransactionByHash, currently geth returns: 

For mined TX
 * The effective gas price

For pending TX:
  * The GasPrice for legacy type0 and type1 Txs, (Legacy)

  * Null for Type2 Txs

excerpts.author: .ethere
excerpts.content:
--

The type field is always there so its an easy fix in the geth consumer side.. if Tx is type 2, then `gasPrice = maxFeePerGas`
